title: Which repositories does M5's concurrency demo use?
body:
The sources conflict. M5 makes S5 possible, and S5's checklist needs dispatches overlapping in three repositories (AssemblyAI#12). But the end-of-milestone rule (AssemblyAI#27) runs every demo path on the fixture repository, and M0 creates only one.

The no-CI part needs no extra repository: the fixture repository's CI can be made absent and the repository declared as having no CI.
rec: A. The demo then shows what S5 checks, before the proving scenarios, without touching real repositories. Two more small repositories are little setup. B runs a milestone demo on your real repositories before the release candidate exists. C leaves the three-repository overlap unseen until the proving scenarios.
options: A: two more small fixture repositories Phillip owns, added in M5 for the demo, so it runs across three
B: the fixture repository plus otman and dev-setup, the proving ground's real repositories
C: concurrent jobs in the fixture repository only; the three-repository overlap waits for S5 on the release candidate

title: Accept M5 Concurrency and limits?
body: Accepting applies your answer above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start M6 Recovery. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
